'''Fist of Yog-Sothoth''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': +2

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Any Phase''': Cast and exhaust to gain +X to [[Combat check]]s until the end of this combat, where X is the number of successes you rolled on your [[Spell check]].

'''Hands''': 1
